audit_item: A10 / EvoTorch checkpoint and native state JSON integrity
finding: E1/E2 checkpoint manifests and the embedded JSON metadata for native optimizer/distribution/population/RNG state were parsed with the default JSON decoder, allowing duplicate keys to be silently overwritten.
change: Added a package-local recursive duplicate-key parser. ESCheckpointStore rejects ambiguous manifests under its corruption RuntimeError contract, and the native-state decoder rejects ambiguous metadata before restoring optimizer state.

verification.pytest_source: duplicate-key and checkpoint resume selector: 8 passed
verification.pytest_installed_wheel: same selector with PYTHONPATH unset: 8 passed, including PGPE/CMA-ES uninterrupted-versus-resumed candidate parity
verification.ruff: passed for new parser, checkpoint, provider, and test module
verification.dependency_check: uv pip check: all 69 RouteB app packages compatible

scope: Temporary synthetic ES checkpoint and native state only; no real optimizer run, market data, or formal evaluation payload was read.
